course_name_original: Müh. Sis. İçin Nümerik Analiz Yaklaşımları ve Uygulamaları (Sektör-Tübitak)
course_name_en: Numerical Analysis Approaches and Applications for Engineering Systems (Industry-TÜBİTAK)

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge about numerical methods.

Gain fundamental understanding on how to set up fluid dynamics simulations using ANSYS Fluent and structural mechanics simulations using ANSYS Mechanical, how to perform analyses, and how to obtain simulation results.
Acquire basic knowledge about how to implement numerical analysis applications in real engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Comparative Analyses of Numerical Methods (FEM, FDM...)
Creating basic solid models with SpaceClaim
Mesh assignment methods for solid models (Homework 1)
Mesh assignment methods for fluid models
bibliography: Chen, X., & Liu, Y. (2018). Finite element modeling and simulation with ANSYS Workbench. CRC press.
Lecheler, S. (2022). Computational Fluid Dynamics: Getting Started Quickly With ANSYS CFX 18 Through Simple Examples. Springer Nature.
